summary: A modernist multi-level structure with a distinctive tiered roof design. The building features a rectangular footprint with stacked horizontal overhangs creating a pyramid-like silhouette. The main body is constructed from brick with stone accents, supported by a stone foundation. A small tower or chimney element protrudes from the left side in some views. The entrance appears to be centered on the front facade.

shape.overall_form: rectangular base with tiered/stepped roof overhangs creating a pyramidal profile
shape.symmetry: bilateral symmetry on front facade; asymmetrical tower element on left side
